page_title: FRE 0-0 UNI | Freiburg v Union Berlin 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+5' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
90+4' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90+2' Nenad Bjelica prepares a substitution. Kevin Volland is replaced by Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Josip Juranovic walks off.
88' A player from Union Berlin commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
84' The ball goes behind for a corner. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

84' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the right side of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow pulls off a great save to deny him.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
83' Here is a change. Vincenzo Grifo is going off and Christian Streich gives the last tactical orders to Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg).
83' Substitution. Lucas Holer (Freiburg) replaces Noah Weisshaupt.
83' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
78' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
77' The foul by Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) was seen by Christian Dingert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
77' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
74' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
70' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
69' Union Berlin earn a corner.
69' A substitution has been made. Jerome Roussillon is replaced by Robin Gosens (Union Berlin).
69' Nenad Bjelica has decided to substitute Brenden Aaronson and he is replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
69' A substitution has been made. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen goes off and Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) comes on.

66' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Noah Atubolu, who pulls off a comfortable save!
64' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
62' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
60' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
60' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Freiburg players are visibly unhappy with the call.
59' There's a break in play and referee Christian Dingert must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Freiburg using VAR. This could be interesting!
58' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Freiburg for a penalty. Play continues.
57' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Christian Dingert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
55' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
54' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
50' A yellow card for a tackle by Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin). Christian Dingert doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
50' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' The total number of attempts is 8:3.
47' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:3.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Frederik Ronnow pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right-hand post.
43' The game is interrupted as Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) is flagged offside.
42' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' A wild effort from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
37' The linesman signals that Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
37' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
35' The free kick from long range, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' A player from Freiburg takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
31' PENALTY APPEAL by Freiburg, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
31' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
30' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Freiburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.
29' Christian Dingert blows his whistle as Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
28' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
27' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) commits a rough foul. Christian Dingert stops the game and makes a call.
25' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
24' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) tackles a bit over-zealously and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.

22' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Noah Atubolu!
19' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
19' Neat passing move from Freiburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Freiburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

16' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Frederik Ronnow shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Freiburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
14' It's a throw-in for Freiburg.
11' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is flagged for offside.
10' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) heads on.
8' A first-time shot by Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
7' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

7' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Freiburg.
6' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
5' The ball is out of play. Freiburg will take a throw-in.
3' An attempted cross from Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) is cleared.
3' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Christian Dingert.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
